how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Raipur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Raipur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Project Associate-I: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering/Information Technology/Cyber Security/Digital Forensics/Artificial Intelligence/Computer Science/Computer Application or equivalent with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks (55% for reserved categories) or equivalent or not less than 6.5 CGPA (5.5 for reserved categories) on 10-point scale or M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/Cyber Security/Digital Forensics or MCA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Raipur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Raipur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur), a prominent government institution located in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Project Associate-I, offering a contractual position within NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position in the National Institute of Technology Raipur recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their online applications for the Project Associate-I post is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates interested in applying for the Project Associate-I positions at NIT Raipur must submit their applications through the online mode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month, along with HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech. in CSE/IT/Cyber Security/Digital Forensics/AI/Computer Science/Computer Application or M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/Cyber Security/Digital Forensics or MCA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Raipur Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Project Associate-I at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Raipur will be based solely on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010. It is a central government institution.
